name: Alphabet Inc.
note: Nasdaq-listed (GOOGL). Per its 2026 proxy (DEF 14A, filed 2026-04-24), the only 'Other > 5% Security Holder' is BlackRock, Inc. (6.1% of Class A); co-founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin hold the controlling Class B votes. Vanguard disaggregated its holdings reporting in January 2026.
